# Faceliora

> Faceliora is consultation software for aesthetic clinics. Faceliora Clinic is 3D facial simulation software that doctors and clinic teams use with the client in the consultation room: injections (filler, toxin, fat), surgery across 13 facial zones, thread lifts and skin analysis, with AI facial analysis at 51 points, summarised in a consultation sheet. Faceliora Scan is an iPhone app that scans a face to build the 3D model; .glb, .obj and .zip files from other scanning apps can also be imported. Faceliora Clinic runs on Mac and Windows. The site is in English and Thai.

Simulations are images for communication. They are not a diagnosis, a prediction or a guarantee of treatment results. Faceliora is software, not a treatment service.
